purpose: Validate the required-field subset of an EUDR Due Diligence Statement (DDS) before TRACES NT filing: operator name, address, EORI, HS code, trade name, quantity, country of production, and geolocation indicator (or micro-operator postal-address exemption). Returns conformant verdict and missing-field list. Root node of the eudr-due-diligence-statement-validation chain. Zero network, zero PII. Reg. EU 2023/1115, mandatory 2026-12-30 (large/medium) / 2027-06-30 (SME).
